fusions.name: Scalding Steam
fusions.desc: Breathes a cone of steam 5 tiles long ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and stunning it for 1 second. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Burning] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Lionspine Sting
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Fires a spine into the first enemy it meets for 6 damage and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Kettle Hide
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Ember Eel
fusions.desc: A bonded eel of fire fights beside you, striking an enemy within 4.5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and setting what it strikes [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.
